# Clutch Marks

> Online revision platform for IGCSE, AS and A2 students of Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science and English — lessons, quizzes, homework, flashcards, past papers, and AI-powered study tools.

A student-and-admin platform for revision in Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Computer Science at IGCSE, AS and A2, and English at IGCSE. Students work through structured lessons by topic, take auto-graded quizzes with AI feedback, submit homework, drill flashcards with spaced repetition, browse a past papers bank, and generate personalized AI study plans. Admins manage content, grade submissions, and track progress. Parents have read-only visibility into their linked student's progress.

## Subjects and levels

Each subject has one hub page per level it is taught at, and each hub lists its topics with revision notes, exam-style questions and past papers.

- [IGCSE Maths](/study/mathematics/ol), [AS Maths](/study/mathematics/as), [A2 Maths](/study/mathematics/a2)
- [IGCSE Physics](/study/physics/ol), [AS Physics](/study/physics/as), [A2 Physics](/study/physics/a2)
- [IGCSE Chemistry](/study/chemistry/ol), [AS Chemistry](/study/chemistry/as), [A2 Chemistry](/study/chemistry/a2)
- [IGCSE Biology](/study/biology/ol), [AS Biology](/study/biology/as), [A2 Biology](/study/biology/a2)
- [IGCSE Computer Science](/study/computer-science/ol), [AS Computer Science](/study/computer-science/as), [A2 Computer Science](/study/computer-science/a2)
- [IGCSE English First Language](/study/english-first-language-cambridge/igcse), [IGCSE English as a Second Language](/study/english-as-a-second-language-oxford/igcse)

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing and sign-in entry point.
- [Sign in](/auth): Username and password login.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Personalized overview with today's tasks, progress, and announcements.
- [Lessons](/lessons): Topic-organized lessons per subject and level.
- [Quizzes](/quizzes): Practice quizzes with auto-grading and AI feedback.
- [Homework](/homework): Assignments with submissions and feedback.
- [Flashcards](/flashcards): Spaced-repetition flashcard decks by topic.
- [Topic Notes](/notes): Search and filter uploaded topic notes by subject, level and keyword.
- [Revision](/revision): Study materials and notes.
- [Past Papers](/past-papers): IGCSE past papers and mark schemes by year and topic.
- [Calendar](/calendar): Deadlines, quizzes, and lesson schedule.
- [Study Planner](/study-planner): AI-generated personalized revision schedules.
- [Progress](/progress): Performance tracking across lessons and quizzes.
- [Announcements](/announcements): Class announcements from admins.

## Optional

- [Admin area](/admin): Restricted admin tools for managing accounts, content, and grading.
